title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy style-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The style-src directive permits plaintext HTTP stylesheets, so CSS that shapes the whole page can be injected by anyone on the network path.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit style-src directive.
risk: Injected CSS can hide or overlay interface elements, restyle a login form and exfiltrate attribute values through selector-driven requests; MEDIUM because it needs the plaintext hop.
